title: 形容词与副词空位
goal: 根据修饰对象和语境选择形容词或副词。

points.label: 根据修饰对象判断所需词性
区分形式相近但意义不同的修饰词

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 形容词常修饰名词，或位于系动词之后。副词可修饰动词或形容词。A quiet room 中，quiet 修饰 room。The room is quiet 中，quiet 作表语。
词尾是判断词性的线索，选词时还要核对句法和意义。hard 和 hardly 都可作副词，意义却不同。

cards.title: 形容词空位
rows: A useful map shows the route.

cards.title: 相近形式的意义
rows: She worked hard to finish the report.
She hardly worked on the report.
The bus has been late lately.
cards.note: hard 也可作形容词，如 hard work；late 也可作形容词，如 a late bus。

body.box:
Mina studied every morning and completed all the exercises. She never studied after noon. She worked _____.
hard / hardly / late / lately

body.p: 每天学习并完成练习说明 Mina 学习努力，hard 符合句意。hardly 表示几乎不，与所述行为相反。

items.stem: The _____ path leads to the lake.
items.why: path 前用形容词 narrow 修饰名词。

items.stem: The guide spoke _____ so the group could hear every word.
items.why: 副词 clearly 修饰动词 spoke。

items.stem: The student made almost no effort and _____ studied.
items.why: almost no effort 表明几乎没有学习，hardly 符合语境。

items.stem: In recent weeks, the library has been busy _____.
items.why: In recent weeks 表示最近一段时间，lately 意义相符。

groups.text: A school bus was delayed by road work yesterday. It arrived after the lesson had begun. The driver explained the delay calmly, and the teacher helped the students enter the room.

items.stem: The driver gave a _____ explanation of the delay.
items.why: explanation 前需要形容词；calm 与原文 calmly 的意义对应。
原文说车在课程开始后到达，late 表示迟到。

items.stem: The _____ room has enough space for the meeting.
items.why: 形容词 large 修饰名词 room。

items.stem: The children listened _____ to the story.
items.why: 副词 attentively 修饰动词 listened。

items.stem: After the repair, the door remained _____.
items.why: 系动词 remained 后用形容词 secure 作表语。

items.stem: The route was _____ short: the walk took only five minutes.
items.why: 副词 surprisingly 修饰形容词 short。

items.stem: The team worked _____ every morning for weeks and finished the project. They never worked after noon.
items.why: 连续工作数周并完成项目表明团队努力工作，hard 符合句意。

items.stem: The box was almost empty; it _____ contained anything.
items.why: almost empty 表示几乎没有东西，hardly 符合句意。

items.stem: The train arrived _____ yesterday, an hour after its scheduled time.
items.why: an hour after its scheduled time 说明火车比预定时间晚到一小时，late 表示晚。

items.stem: In the past few weeks, the shop has been busy _____.
items.why: In the past few weeks 表示最近一段时间，lately 意义相符。
